The analysis of the tracking error E(s) in a feedback control system to understand the effects of reference inputs, disturbances, and measurement noise.
一种控制校正方式，通过在系统中引入前馈通路来改善系统性能，包括前置滤波组合校正和最小节拍组合校正。
A control compensation method that improves system performance by introducing feedforward paths into the system, including prefilter composite compensation and deadbeat composite compensation.
由于无源网络无法提供纯微分信号，在前馈装置传递函数分母上额外引入的 (Ts+1) 项，影响系统动态性能。

The (Ts+1) term additionally introduced into the denominator of the feedforward device transfer function because passive networks cannot provide pure differentiation, which affects system dynamic performance.
奈奎斯特稳定判据是根据奈奎斯特图上的 (-1,0) 点或伯德图上的 0-dB、-180° 点定义的。L(jω) 轨迹与该稳定点的接近程度，是衡量系统相对稳定性的度量。

The Nyquist stability criterion is defined in terms of the (-1,0) point on the Nyquist plot or the 0-dB, -180° point on the Bode plot. The proximity of the L(jω)-locus to this stability point is a measure of the relative stability of a system.
式 (9.58) 是二阶系统阻尼比 ζ 与相角裕度 φ_pm 之间的近似线性关系，其中 ζ=0.01 φ_pm，且相角裕度以度为单位。
Equation (9.58) is an approximate linear relationship between the damping ratio ζ and the phase margin φ_pm for a second-order system, where ζ=0.01 φ_pm and the phase margin is measured in degrees.
一种相对稳定性的度量，定义为相角达到 -180°（即 v=0）时的频率处增益 |L(jω)| 的倒数。它是为了使 L(jω) 轨迹通过 u=-1 点而必须增加系统增益的倍数。

A measure of relative stability defined as the reciprocal of the gain |L(jω)| at the frequency at which the phase angle reaches -180° (that is, v=0). It is the factor by which the system gain would have to be increased for the L(jω) locus to pass through the u=-1 point.
s平面中包围整个右半s平面的闭合曲线Γ_s，用于依据柯西定理判定稳定性。
A contour Γ_s in the s-plane that encloses the entire right-hand s-plane, used to determine stability via Cauchy's theorem.
奈奎斯特判据提供了关于绝对稳定性的信息，并可用于定义和确定系统的相对稳定性。
The Nyquist criterion provides information concerning absolute stability and can be utilized to define and ascertain the relative stability of a system.
式 (9.57) 给出了回路传递函数为 L(s)=ω_n^2/(s(s+2ζω_n)) 的二阶系统的阻尼比 ζ 与相角裕度 φ_pm 之间的关系。
Equation (9.57) provides the relationship between the damping ratio ζ and the phase margin φ_pm for a second-order system with loop transfer function L(s)=ω_n^2/(s(s+2ζω_n)).
通过某种对应关系从一个平面映射或变换到另一个平面的围道或轨迹。
A contour or trajectory in one plane mapped or translated into another plane by a relation.
一种相对稳定性的度量，定义为使 L(jω) 平面上的单位幅值点 |L(jω)|=1 通过 (-1,0) 点时，L(jω) 轨迹所需旋转的相角。它等于系统达到不稳定前所需的附加相位滞后量。

A measure of relative stability defined as the phase angle through which the L(jω) locus must be rotated so that the unity magnitude |L(jω)|=1 point will pass through the (-1,0) point in the L(jω) plane. It is equal to the additional phase lag required before the system becomes unstable.
式 (9.55) 使二阶系统 L(jω)=ω_n^2/(jω(jω+2ζω_n)) 的频率响应幅值在截止频率 ω_c 处等于 1。
Equation (9.55) sets the magnitude of the frequency response equal to 1 at the crossover frequency ω_c for the second-order system L(jω)=ω_n^2/(jω(jω+2ζω_n)).
在s平面上，系统的相对稳定性是由各根或各对根的相对调节时间来衡量的特性。调节时间较短的系统被认为相对更为稳定。

For the s-plane, the relative stability of a system is the property measured by the relative settling time of each root or pair of roots. A system with a shorter settling time is considered relatively more stable.
定义为 1 加上回路传递函数 L(s) 的函数 F(s)。
The function F(s) defined as 1 plus the loop transfer function L(s).
幅值裕度和相角裕度很容易从伯德图求得。在 L(jω) 平面中，稳定性的临界点为 u=-1, v=0，这等价于伯德图上对数幅值为 0 dB 且相角为 180°（或 -180°）。

The gain and phase margins are easily evaluated from the Bode plot. The critical point for stability is u=-1, v=0 in the L(jω)-plane, which is equivalent to a logarithmic magnitude of 0 dB and a phase angle of 180° (or -180°) on the Bode plot.
反馈控制系统稳定的充要条件是：对于闭合曲线 Γ_L，包围 (-1,0) 点的逆时针圈数等于 L(s) 具有正实部的极点数。

A feedback control system is stable if and only if, for the contour Γ_L, the number of counterclockwise encirclements of the (-1,0) point is equal to the number of poles of L(s) with positive real parts.
方程 F(s)=1+L(s)=0，其零点决定系统的稳定性。
The equation F(s)=1+L(s)=0, whose zeros determine system stability.
系统的频率响应可以用对数幅值-相角图直观表示。在对数幅相图中，临界稳定点为 (0 dB, -180°)，幅值裕度和相位裕度可以很方便地在图上确定并标出。

The frequency response of a system can be graphically portrayed on the logarithmic-magnitude-phase-angle diagram. For the log-magnitude-phase diagram, the critical stability point is the 0-dB, -180° point, and the gain margin and phase margin can be easily determined and indicated on the diagram.
闭环根为 s = -ζω_n ± jω_n √(1-ζ^2)。
The closed-loop roots are s = -ζω_n ± jω_n √(1-ζ^2).
相对稳定性的另一种度量方式可以根据特定系统与处于临界稳定状态的系统之间的相角裕度来定义。
An alternative measure of relative stability can be defined in terms of the phase margin between a specific and a system that is marginally stable.
F(s) 在奈奎斯特围道内的零点数 Z 等于对原点的包围圈数 N 加上 L(s) 在围道内的极点数 P。
The number of zeros Z of F(s) within the Nyquist contour equals the number of encirclements N of the origin plus the number of poles P of L(s) within the contour.
s 平面上包围整个右半 s 平面的闭合曲线 Γ_s，用于借助柯西定理判定稳定性。
A contour Γ_s in the s-plane that encloses the entire right-hand s-plane, used to determine stability via Cauchy's theorem.
相角裕度是指在幅值为 1 时，L(jω) 能够使系统处于临界稳定并在奈奎斯特图上穿过 -1+j0 点所需的相移量。
The phase margin is the amount of phase shift of the L(jω) at unity magnitude that will result in a marginally stable system with intersection of the -1+j0 point on the Nyquist plot.
一种在 F(s) 平面上保持 s 平面围线夹角的映射。
A type of mapping that retains the angles of the s-plane contour on the F(s)-plane.
将奈奎斯特围线 Γ_s 经由函数 F(s) 映射到 F(s) 平面上所得到的围线 Γ_F。
The contour Γ_F in the F(s)-plane resulting from mapping the Nyquist contour Γ_s through the function F(s).
反馈控制系统稳定的充要条件是：对于闭合曲线 Γ_L，包围 (-1,0) 点的逆时针圈数等于 L(s) 具有正实部的极点数。

A feedback control system is stable if and only if, for the contour Γ_L, the number of counterclockwise encirclements of the (-1,0) point is equal to the number of poles of L(s) with positive real parts.
用主导二阶系统近似高阶系统是一种有效的方法。式 (9.58) 是二阶系统的合适近似；若可以假定系统的瞬态响应主要由一对主导欠阻尼根决定，则该式也可用于高阶系统。

The approximation of a higher-order system by a dominant second-order system is a useful approximation. Equation (9.58) is a suitable approximation for a second-order system and may be used for higher-order systems if we can assume that the transient response of the system is primarily due to a pair of dominant underdamped roots.
闭环频率响应的最大幅值，是频域中一个有用的性能指标。
The maximum magnitude of the closed-loop frequency response, a useful index of performance in the frequency domain.
1+L(s) 在 s 右半平面内的根（零点）数由 Z = N + P 表示。
The number of roots (zeros) of 1+L(s) in the right-hand s-plane is represented by Z = N + P.
幅值裕度是指当相位为 -180° 时系统增益的增加量，该增加量将导致系统处于临界稳定状态并在奈奎斯特图上与 -1+j0 点相交。
The gain margin is the increase in the system gain when phase = -180° that will result in a marginally stable system with intersection of the -1+j0 point on the Nyquist plot.
该近似在 ζ ≤ 0.7 时具有相当的准确度，是建立系统频域响应与暂态性能关联的有用指标。
This approximation is reasonably accurate for ζ ≤ 0.7 and is a useful index for correlating the frequency response with the transient performance of a system.
相角裕度是一种用于指示系统预期瞬态性能的频域响应指标。
The phase margin is a frequency response measure for indicating the expected transient performance of a system.
如果 s 平面中的闭合曲线 Γ_s 包围了 F(s) 的 Z 个零点和 P 个极点，且不穿过 F(s) 的任何零点或极点，并且沿曲线顺时针方向遍历，则 F(s) 平面中对应的闭合曲线 Γ_F 将沿顺时针方向包围 F(s) 平面的原点 N=Z-P 次。

If a contour Γ_s in the s-plane encircles Z zeros and P poles of F(s) and does not pass through any poles or zeros of F(s) and the traversal is in the clockwise direction along the contour, the corresponding contour Γ_F in the F(s)-plane encircles the origin of the F(s)-plane N=Z-P times in the clockwise direction.
式 (9.47) 用对数（分贝）量度将幅值裕度定义为 20 log(1/d) = -20 log d dB。
Equation (9.47) defines the gain margin in terms of a logarithmic (decibel) measure as 20 log(1/d) = -20 log d dB.
当 K 降低到临界值以下时，稳定性增加，临界增益 K=(τ1+τ2)/(τ1τ2) 与增益 K=K2 之间的裕度是相对稳定性的度量。
As K is decreased below the marginal value, the stability is increased, and the margin between the critical gain K=(τ1+τ2)/(τ1τ2) and a gain K=K2 is a measure of the relative stability.
式 (9.45) 给出了与 u 轴的交点：u = -K τ_1 τ_2 / (τ_1+τ_2)。
Equation (9.45) gives the intersection point on the u-axis: u = -K τ_1 τ_2 / (τ_1+τ_2).
L(s)=K/(s(τ₁s+1)(τ₂s+1)) 的奈奎斯特图与实轴相交处的频率为 ω=1/√(τ₁τ₂)。
The frequency at which the Nyquist plot of L(s)=K/(s(τ₁s+1)(τ₂s+1)) intersects the real axis is ω=1/√(τ₁τ₂).
式 (9.53) 为闭环二阶系统的特征方程：s^2 + 2ζω_n s + ω_n^2 = 0。
Equation (9.53) is the characteristic equation for the closed-loop second-order system: s^2 + 2ζω_n s + ω_n^2 = 0.
奈奎斯特围道中从 ω=0+ 到 ω=+∞ 的部分通过函数 L(jω) 的映射。
The mapping of the portion of the Nyquist contour from ω=0+ to ω=+∞ through the function L(jω).

The Routh stability criterion is presented in tabular form, as shown in Table 3-4 (Routh array). The first two rows of the Routh array are directly formed from the coefficients of the system characteristic equation (3-68). The first row consists of the 1st, 3rd, 5th, ... coefficients of the characteristic equation; the second row consists of the 2nd, 4th, 6th, ... coefficients. Subsequent rows in the Routh array are calculated row by row as shown in Table 3-4, and any empty positions occurring during the computation are replaced by zeros. This process continues up to the nth row; the (n+1)th row has a value only in the first column, which equals the last coefficient an of the characteristic equation.
